q: Which organism has the most genes?
Calculate how many times more DNA a human has than a fruit fly.
Humans have far more DNA than rice but fewer genes. Suggest why.
Most human DNA is non-coding (does not code for proteins); genes are only a small part of it.
Evaluate the claim "more genes make an organism more complex" using the data.
Not supported: rice and the water flea have more genes than humans. Complexity depends on how genes are controlled and used, not just their number.
